metadata.task: Navigate to the patient room, collect the used food tray, and place it in the designated collection area.

plan.goal: Navigate to a patient room, pick up a used food tray, and transport it to a collection area.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to a patient room to locate the used food tray.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at an initial location (e.g., Main Entrance or Reception).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has successfully navigated to a patient room and identified a used food tray.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must navigate to the room to access the object.
Robot must perceive the used food tray to enable picking.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the used food tray from the patient room.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is in the patient room and has detected the used food tray.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the used food tray.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must execute a grasp and lift action to secure the tray.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the designated collection area with the tray.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the used food tray in the patient room.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has arrived at the collection area while holding the tray.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must navigate to the collection area to deposit the tray.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the used food tray in the collection area.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the collection area holding the used food tray.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the used food tray in the collection area.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot must execute a release action to deposit the tray.

constraints: Used food tray must exist in the world state.
Collection area must exist in the world state.
Patient room must exist in the world state.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: Robot successfully navigates to a patient room, detects and picks up a used food tray, navigates to the collection area, and places the tray there.
